title: fix(lint,metadata-protocol,rest,runtime): refuse a sum/avg roll-up the engine cannot recompute, and answer a landed child write's success
body:
domain:server#5 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oc56xChD6Wrc4cGSt

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X8dNy8r76WjFsVdvaSJbXXR)_

Fixes #28661

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md` and `rules/field-types.md` teach `summaryOperations` only with `sum` over a numeric `amount` and `count`; no file under `skills/**` teaches a `sum`/`avg` over a text field, and every taught example stays admitted.

## 维护者速读

- 问题：已发布的汇总字段对文本子字段做 `sum`/`avg` 时，子记录每次增改删都答 500，但写入其实已落库；客户端重试 create 会产生重复记录。
- 前半：汇总规则从只在 `os lint` 里跑，搬进作者规则注册表（gating），`os validate`、`os build`、`os lint` 和运行时保存/发布门都会拒绝；草稿的 `_diagnostics` 也报出来。
- 子对象不存在（`qsf_nope`）没有拒绝：全量 dogfood 测到 unmanaged install 会先写父对象、后写它汇总的子对象，拒绝会打断这种安装；按派单第 2 条放行，列为待决问题。
- 后半：写入已落库、只是父记录汇总重算失败时，REST 和运行时分发器的 POST/PATCH/DELETE 答写入本身的成功响应（201/200，与正常成功同一个 body，不加新字段、不加新错误码）；汇总列过期这件事按字段只在日志里以 error 说一次。
- protocol 的 `createData`/`updateData`/`deleteData` 仍抛 `ERR_SUMMARY_RECOMPUTE`（带 `written`），导入和种子加载的契约不变；未改 `packages/spec/**`。
- 需要你看：子对象不存在要不要以别的方式处理（见 Acceptance notes）；表单提交、批量写、clone、MCP 等其它写入门未在本 PR 处理。

## What changes

**Half 1 — the doors refuse a roll-up the engine refuses at every recompute.**

- `packages/lint`: the roll-up rule (`lintSummaryRollups`, `data-model-rules.ts`) leaves `lintDataModel` and becomes a gating entry of the authoring-rule registry (`authoring-rules.ts`), on all three commands and at the runtime object door (`runtimeTypes: ['object']`). It judges:
  - `sum`/`avg` over a child field outside the aggregate × field-type table (`isAggregateCompatibleWithFieldType`, `@objectstack/spec`'s `AGGREGATE_FIELD_TYPE_COMPATIBILITY` — the predicate the engine's aggregate door already refuses with) → `rollup/non-numeric-aggregand` at `objects.<parent>.fields.<field>.summaryOperations.field`, naming the accepted child types and `count`;
  - `min`/`max` (the arm `os lint` already reported, same message and fix) — now also gating at `os validate` and `os build`;
  - a `summaryOperations.object` naming no object the pass holds stays SILENT at every door — see Acceptance notes for the measured reason.
- `os explain rollup/non-numeric-aggregand` now covers `sum`/`avg`.
- The draft read already folds the publish verdict into `_diagnostics` (#26707), so a draft carrying such a roll-up now reads `valid: false` with the same entry publish refuses with.

**Half 2 — a child write that landed answers its success.**

- `packages/metadata-protocol`: `createData`, `updateData` and `deleteData` build the answer the write earned when the engine throws `ERR_SUMMARY_RECOMPUTE` ("the triggering records WERE written"), attach it to the refusal under a non-enumerable symbol, and rethrow — so every existing caller (import runner, seed loader) reads the refusal exactly as before. The carrier lives in `@objectstack/types` (`summary-recompute-answer.ts`), the one package the protocol, `rest` and `runtime` all depend on (`rest` has the protocol as a dev dependency only).
- `packages/rest` (`crud-routes.ts`, `stale-summary-answer.ts`) and `packages/runtime` (`domains/data.ts`): `POST`, `PATCH`, `DELETE /data/:object[/:id]` answer that earned body with the write's own success status (201/200), plus the dropped-fields header the success path sets. No member, header or code is added; the body is the one the same write answers when every roll-up recomputes.
- The stale summary column is logged at `error`, once per child object and summary field, with the consequence and the fix (AGENTS.md degradation-log rule); the engine's own `warn` per failure is unchanged.

**Gate fallout.** `check:engine-double-contract`'s by-id seam scan now also reads a receipt returned through a same-function `const answer = { … }` (the `const opts = { where: { id } }` reading it already makes, applied to the answer), with an A/B self-test pair; its ledger learns the new test file's engine double. Four docs transcripts move from 59 to 60 author-time rules (main's #28775 had already moved them from 58 to 59).

## Tests

All red on the merge base `2678600d` and green on the head.

- `packages/lint` — `data-model-rules.summary-rollup.test.ts`: `sum`/`avg` over text refused with the exact message, path and fix; table parity over every `FieldType` for both functions; `sum` over `percent` refused, `avg` admitted; `sum` over a number admitted; a missing child raises nothing; `lintDataModel` no longer reports it; `os explain` facts. `runtime-gate.object-writes.test.ts`: the door refuses `sum`/`avg` over text at `objects.qsf_parent.fields.probe_sf.summaryOperations.field`, admits `sum(amount)`, admits a parent whose child does not exist yet (with and without a closure), refuses the CHILD write that turns a summed field into text, does not charge a write for a stored parent already in violation; roster pins list the rule. `data-model-rules.fix-lines.test.ts`: one-line fix.
- `packages/metadata-protocol` — `protocol.summary-rollup-publish-gate.test.ts` (9): active save 422 `INVALID_METADATA` for `sum` and `avg`; the draft saves, reads `_diagnostics.valid: false` with `rollup/non-numeric-aggregand`, and both `publishMetaItem` and `publishPackageDrafts` refuse; `sum(amount)` admitted; missing child admitted by save and publish; a draft child in the same package publish is judged with its parent (numeric admitted, text refused). Base: 5 red / 4 green (the controls).
- `packages/rest` — `data-write-summary-recompute-refused.test.ts` (5, real `SqlDriver` on better-sqlite3): POST 201 with the created record, persisted once, `child_sum` 295 / `child_count` 3; PATCH 200, `child_sum` 230; DELETE 200 `{object,id,success:true}`, `child_sum` 95 / `child_count` 2; one `error` line naming `qsf_parent.probe_sf`; the protocol's `createData` still throws `ERR_SUMMARY_RECOMPUTE` with `written`. Base: POST/PATCH/DELETE answered 500.
- `packages/runtime` — `domains/data-write-summary-recompute-refused.test.ts` (4): the dispatcher's `/data` door answers the same 201/200 bodies, persists once, recomputes the valid roll-ups, and logs once through the host logger. Base: 4/4 red.
- Ablations (each mutation landed on disk, restored to the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty): sum/avg arm off → lint 6 red; registry `runtimeTypes` emptied → lint 4 red; earned-answer symbol detached (dist rebuilt) → REST 4 red; REST POST relay disabled → REST 1 red; runtime `data.ts` at base → runtime 4 red.
- Suites: `@objectstack/lint` 7730/7730, `@objectstack/rest` 7203 passed (352 skipped), `@objectstack/runtime` 9194 passed (19 skipped), `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` 21958 passed (26 skipped; 4 reds in two ssl-redaction files from `main` were a stale post-merge dist and went green after rebuilding `spec`), `@objectstack/types` 846/846.
- Full dogfood on the head `fe13d22d` (after merging `main` at `5493b884`, closure rebuilt): Test Files 374 passed, 3 skipped (377); Tests 3034 passed, 28 skipped (3062). On the same head: `@objectstack/lint` 7775/7775, and the three new door files 9 / 5 / 4 passed.

## Acceptance notes

- **The narrowing is already denied by published text.** `@objectstack/spec`'s `AGGREGATE_FIELD_TYPE_COMPATIBILITY` (the aggregate × field-type table) does not admit `sum`/`avg` over `text`, and the engine's aggregate door refuses the pair with its own message ("sums 'memo', a declared text field, which the engine does not sum") — on a roll-up after the write committed, every time. The lint rule's published message for `rollup/non-numeric-aggregand` already refused the `min`/`max` arm on `os lint`. No roll-up the engine could recompute is newly refused.
- **The missing-child half is admitted (open question).** The first full dogfood on this branch refused it and turned 9 cases of `install-local-unmanaged-mode.dogfood.test.ts` red: the unmanaged install saves `crm_opportunity` (`line_total = sum(crm_opportunity_line_item.amount)`) one active save before the child exists. Per the order, the arm was removed and the case is left open; a missing child keeps reading 0 / null, and nothing fails.
- **Census.** `examples/app-showcase` (24 objects, 9 roll-ups), `examples/app-crm` (6, 1), `examples/app-todo` (1, 0) through the built rule: 0 findings. `examples/app-multi-package` declares no summary field. `hotcrm`'s one roll-up is `sum` over a `currency` field: admitted.
- **Doors not changed.** Form submit (`form-routes.ts`), the batch and `*ManyData` routes, `cloneData`, the MCP `create_record` bridge and `callData`'s ObjectQL fallback (no protocol registered) still surface `ERR_SUMMARY_RECOMPUTE` as before. Only the card's three data doors, on both transports, answer the earned body.
- No `packages/spec/**` edit.

## Verification

Live probe on a stock showcase boot, card steps 2–4. Sign in as the seeded admin, install a scratch package, author `qsf_parent` (`child_sum = sum(amount)`, `child_count = count`) and `qsf_child` (`memo` text, `amount` number, `parent` master_detail), publish, then seed P and two children:

```
pnpm dev -- --fresh -p <port>
curl -X POST /api/v1/auth/sign-in/email -d '{"email":"admin@objectos.ai","password":"admin123"}'
curl -X POST /api/v1/packages -d '{"manifest":{"id":"app.qsf","name":"QSF","version":"0.1.0","type":"app","namespace":"qsf"},"enableOnInstall":true}'
curl -X PUT '/api/v1/meta/object/qsf_parent?mode=draft&package=app.qsf' -d '<parent + probe_sf = {object:qsf_child, function:sum, field:memo}>'   # step 2
curl '/api/v1/meta/object/qsf_parent?state=draft&package=app.qsf'                                                                   # _diagnostics
curl -X POST /api/v1/packages/app.qsf/publish-drafts -d '{}'                                                                       # step 3
curl -X PATCH /api/v1/data/qsf_child/qsfc1 -d '{"amount":31}'                                                                     # step 4
curl -X POST /api/v1/data/qsf_child -d '{"id":"qsfy1","name":"y1","amount":60,"parent":"qsfp1"}'
curl -X DELETE /api/v1/data/qsf_child/qsfy1
```

| | base (`lint`/`metadata-protocol`/`rest`/`runtime` at `2678600d`) | head |
|---|---|---|
| step 2 `_diagnostics` | `{"valid":true}` | `valid:false`, `rollup/non-numeric-aggregand` (sum and avg) |
| step 3 publish | `published` | `refused`, `rollup/non-numeric-aggregand` at `…probe_sf.summaryOperations.field` |
| step 4 PATCH / POST / DELETE | 500 / 500 / 500 `INTERNAL_ERROR` (row persisted, `child_sum` 91 → 151 → 91) | 200 / 201 / 200 (row persisted once, `child_sum` 168 → 228 → 168), one `[REST]` error line for `qsf_parent.probe_sf` |
| `probe_nope` (missing child) | published | published (admitted) |

Step 4 on head was taken on a boot with only `@objectstack/lint` at base, because the head gate no longer lets the bad roll-up be stored.

Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 112 commands on the head `fe13d22d`; all 112 exit 0, and `--ran` reconciles 112 derived, 112 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. Scoped `pnpm lint` over the 17 changed `.ts`/`.mjs` files: exit 0. `pnpm check:nul-bytes`: exit 0. Typecheck (`tsc --noEmit`) of `lint`, `metadata-protocol`, `rest`, `runtime` and `types`: exit 0 each.
